name: netrunner
description: Netrunner: a cyber theme for Claude Code (desktop app and terminal, Windows, macOS, Linux). A status band above the prompt, animated subagent crabs, and four color variants.

plugins.name: netrunner
plugins.description: The Netrunner theme: the whole app's colors with a slow network-map background, a status band (usage, prompt cache, WAITING line, sweep) and four transcript skins: Packet Trace, Zero Day, Cold Boot and Black ICE.

plugins.name: netrunner-crew
plugins.description: Walking hacker crabs for running subagents: a crew row above the prompt (it joins Netrunner's WAITING line) and an agents panel (/crew).
